text:
**False as a general claim.** The Great Wall is generally **not discernible with the naked eye from low Earth orbit**, and it cannot be seen unaided from the Moon. Despite its length, it is only a few metres wide and blends into the surrounding terrain.

**Nuance:** Exceptional naked-eye sightings from low Earth orbit have been reported, so “never visible from space” would also be too absolute. Photographs taken with telephoto lenses do not establish naked-eye visibility.

**Source:** NASA, *“China’s Wall Less Great in View from Space”* (2005).
